 Japan v Brazil LIVE: Vinicius Jr gives Selecao hope after quickfire Kubo and Nakamura goals
 The Selecao battle the Samurai Blue in Singapore in a rematch of the last-32 World Cup 2026 clash, which saw Gabriel Martinelli’s stoppage-time strike earn progress for the five-time world champions
 Jamie Braidwood Saturday 14 November 2026 11:22 GMT

 Japan's Takefusa Kubo scores against Brazil ( AP ) Brazil face Japan in a friendly as Carlo Ancelotti bids for momentum after a disappointing World Cup 2026. The Selecao broke the hearts of the Samurai Blue and their followers in Houston this summer, dumping out Hajime Moriyasu’s side 2-1 at the last-32 stage . 
 The result, inspired by Gabriel Martinelli’s late goal, dashed Japan’s hopes after a promising tournament, though Ancelotti’s side fell at the next stage at the hands of Norway and an inspired Erling Haaland, leaving a nation searching for answers. 
 Now, Ancelotti must quickly build momentum to bring the Brazilian public back onside, having won against India and secured a win and a draw against Australia in the last international break. Arsenal’s Bruno Guimaraes and Gabriel Magalhaes should be involved, while Barcelona’s Raphinha could shake off a knock to join Vinicius Jr in attack.
 Meanwhile, this international break is expected to see the end of an era with Moriyasu poised to step down following the game next week against Paraguay. Follow all the build-up and action to this friendly below:

 Japan v Brazil
 Brilliant Japan take two-goal lead against Brazil in World Cup rematch 
 35' GOAL! Vinicius Jr gives Brazil hope with rocket into top corner [JPN 2-1 BRA] 
 19' GOAL! Nakamura left alone to thump Japan into two-goal lead [JPN 2-0 BRA] 
 15' GOAL! Kubo dribbles from halfway before finding finish [JPN 1-0 BRA] 
 Japan XI: Suzuki; Seko, Nakano, Machida; Doan, Ito, Kamada, Nakamura; Tanaka, Maeda, Kubo 
 Brazil XI: Morisco; Wesley, Jair, Gabriel, Augusto; Andrey Santos, Guimaraes, Andre; Estevao, Raphinha, Vinicius Jr 
 KICK-OFF! Japan 2-1 Brazil
 Carlo Ancelotti had some angry words for the referee at the half-time whistle but his Brazil team were all over the place at times as Japan took a two-goal lead. They were much better after Vinicius Jr pulled one back. 
 What Brazil will we see in the second half? Back underway with no changes made. 
 Jamie Braidwood 14 November 2026 11:22 HALF TIME! Japan 2-1 Brazil
 Well, for a friendly, that’s been an exciting half of football in Singapore. Japan made a brilliant start and stunned Brazil by scoring twice in 20 minutes. Brazil’s defence disappeared in a disastrous five-minute spell and Japan took full advantage with goals from Kubo and Nakamura, with Maeda going close as well. But Brazil responded well. Vinicius Jr unleashed a rocket of a shot into the top corner and it was all Brazil until the half-time whistle. 
 It’s set up well for the second half, that’s for sure. 
 Jamie Braidwood 14 November 2026 11:05 Japan 2-1 Brazil
 44 mins: SAVE! Brazil are almost level! Andre steps in to win the ball in midfield and then keeps on driving. He reaches the edge of the box before unleashing a shot that forces Suzuki into the diving stop! 
 ( Reuters ) Jamie Braidwood 14 November 2026 11:02 Japan 2-1 Brazil
 43 mins: Raphinha leads appeals for a penalty after breaking into the box and going down under the challenge of the Japan defender! But the referee waves Brazil’s appeals away! 
 Jamie Braidwood 14 November 2026 11:00 Japan 2-1 Brazil
 42 mins: Vinicius Jr threatens from the left but Japan are doubling up on the winger and he has to settle for the corner. Japan clear. 
 Jamie Braidwood 14 November 2026 10:58 Japan 2-1 Brazil 
 36 mins: ‘Not this again’, Japan must be thinking. Can Brazil complete another comeback against Japan? That Vinicius rocket has set up the rest of the game wonderfully. 
 ( Reuters ) Jamie Braidwood 14 November 2026 10:53 GOAL! Japan 2-1 Brazil (VINICIUS 32')
 WOOOOW WHAT A HIT! 
 Estevao should have scored moments before but was denied by Suzuki. Instead, Vinicius goes himself and arrow and unstoppable shot across goal and into the top corner. 
 Brazil are back in it! 
 Jamie Braidwood 14 November 2026 10:50 Japan 2-0 Brazil
 30 mins: Japan have been relentless in their press and have swarmed Brazil in midfield. They look up for it in a way Carlo Ancelotti’s side simply do not. 
 Jamie Braidwood 14 November 2026 10:48 Japan 2-0 Brazil
 26 mins: Raphinha’s cross looks for Vinicius at the back post but it evades the Real Madrid forward. The referee delays the restart, perhaps to check a pull on Vinicius, but it’s then given the all clear. 
 Jamie Braidwood 14 November 2026 10:44 Japan 2-0 Brazil 
 22 mins: Brazil are stunned. Carlo Ancelotti’s side were carved open three times in five minutes and now require a two-goal comeback to save themselves from defeat.
